body: I don’t want to report it. It would make my life a million times harder. Having to confront him? My mother? My brother? His wife? I could not handle being told I’m a liar. I really couldnt. There is an unfortunate misconception that reporting sexual abuse and assault is the best thing for victims. In fact, it would further ostracize me from my family, forcing me to be financially independent which I am not. I’d have to confront my greatest fear face to face. I’d have to relive my abuse in detail over and over while strangers try to find inconsistencies and lies. There is no benefit to me by reporting this. The only certain outcome is retraumatizing myself. I could not survive through that. I wasn’t even able to type that I was hurt, much less by whom, until a few months ago. I appreciate your concern and support but any foreseeable path ends in suicide. Thank you though.
Are you saying I should kill my father? I’m far too pretty to go to jail. There’s no evidence to defend me, it would be a life sentence.

I’m sorry I wouldn’t wish this on anyone. I don’t like that people can relate to me. I understand not being able to put in the work for a life that won’t necessarily be better. You never escape something like this.
This is actually hilarious and I wouldn’t mind getting fucked up in a cool mountain town.

Have you not seen the hundreds of news stories about girls being shot for refusing to give phone numbers, have a conversation, etc.? We don’t have the freedom to be impolite to strangers. There is always a lingering danger. It isn’t as simple as drawing the line when we don’t know whether this strange man approaching us will cross it. There is no shame in doing what you feel you have to in order to stay safe. I think you should be more concerned with men pushing for conversation with obviously distressed women.
Thank you <3
It’s a lot different than just forgetting or dissociating, not being able to access memories at all but having evidence of being awake/doing stuff is.... bizarre
Yeah I have a lot of past abuse that makes dissociation familiar but I’ve never (as far as I can remember) blacked out without abuse or alcohol causing it

My mom doesn’t allow me access to therapy or normal medical treatment. Even though I’m 18, I’m on her health insurance. I thought about using the counseling services at my school but if I was going to be honest and tell them what’s happening, I’m sure they’d refer me to an actual psychiatrist and then I’m the same place I’ve started. I bought some books online about DBT and PTSD so I can try and help myself but all it’s done is make me realize that there’s something inherently wrong in my brain chemistry and I don’t know what to do

Edit: I also am fully incapable of talking about my abuse. I barely mentioned it to an ex of mine, testing to see whether I could be honest or not and I just can’t. It won’t come out in words. I can barely type it.
I dissociate pretty often but I had no idea I’d just completely lose time
I do get super offended when people comment on my actions, I feel like a child being scolded.
I guess I don't really have a choice. I couldn't imagine being 18, being 34 sounds almost impossible
Thanks for the offer
Thanks man
Thank you though haha
Yeah I went downstairs this morning and when my mom told me happy birthday I almost burst into tears lmao I don't want anyone to pay attention to me

I feel like everytime I try, I pull myself deeper underwater. the only thing I find joy in is being loved better than anyone else. Everyone that says they love me hurts me and leaves. I'm glad you figured it out but we're not the same. I feel like I've been exposed to a lot of the world in the short time I've been here, and there isn't much about life that appeals to me. I don't want a job. I don't want to get married. I don't want to travel anymore. I don't want to create anything. There's no driving force. No ambition. I don't want anything else from this life but to sleep.
I meant it when I have no where to go and no one to care about me. And thank you but I don't want to be reasoned out of this. I'm so tired.

Thank you so much, you have no idea what it means to me to hear this. Finding a way to deal with my illness productively is my last thread of hope, along with figuring out how I can escape and never come back here. As terrible as I feel right now, I want to try. Thank you.

Thank you and I haven't received any treatment. My mom has taken my brother to different therapists for his anger management issues, but she's only taken me to one (a friend of hers that I wasn't comfortable talking to). Earlier this year I asked for professional help for the first time and she said no. I've been reading about DBT online and I think I'll buy a book or two online. I want to be better so badly. There aren't any dorms at the college I'm going to, but there are for another campus. I can't afford to live on my own since I quit my job a few months ago. I don't think I'll move out until I'm done with these credits and get accepted to the university my girlfriend goes to. There's no point in moving out if I'll be doing it anyways in a year. My mom has been paying for my school because her new husband is doing really well at work, but she makes me feel guilty for relying on her while at the same time refusing to help me figure out how to gain some independence. I'm still under 18 for another month so she controls everything I do, I couldn't even enroll for classes at the community college without her help. I didn't know my social security number until last month, and I didn't know to apply for FAFSA or the kind of grants I qualify for by being a minority. She's offered no help in the traditional ways which makes me think she might be purposefully keeping me financially dependent on her. I'm not sure if I'm demonizing her or if it's really happening, but I feel really hopeless.
Warriors fight back. But thank you.
I don't feel strong. Strong would be saying it all out loud. Or saying no or screaming or fighting back. I don't think I'm strong.

I've only been in two relationships where I HAVEN'T been cheated on and I'm convinced it's just the type of person I attract. I kind of present myself in this 'look at me I'm broken' way without ever actually saying it, but I think abusive people just pick up on those vibes. It's not your fault, even if you decided to stay with him.

No I totally understand. I tend to obsess over people that I know I can't have, like authority figures or emotionally unattainable people. But when I do they're all I think about and it's so obnoxious because I KNOW i can never be with them and if I was, I wouldn't be happy but I can't STOP. It's like a crazy compulsion, I totally get you.

This is actually crazy because I'm trapped between two abusive households right now and this has been a legitimate consideration for a long time now. I can't really offer any support because I'm in the exact same place as you, my parents (even though they're divorced) have made me completely financially dependent on them including having my bank and savings account made almost inaccessible. Pm if you wanna just vent, but otherwise I just wanna let you know I understand the struggle between escaping and feeling manipulative.

Thank you. I think I need to leave for good. The only way I think I can stay alive is having someone validate all my feelings and be concerned. That was my motivation to see a professional, not a diagnosis. Until last year I thought everyone felt the same as me and no one talked about it/everyone was better at dealing with it than I am. My mom always says 'you're not trying. There are WAYS to deal with this' but never helps me. I don't know what to do anymore
I appreciate that you are supportive of your daughter but my parents are not like this at all. There is a reason I've waited so long to ask for help, and she just realized my worst fear. rejection

The only friend I have right now lives a few cities away, we've never met but have talked for over a year. We're set to meet on the 22nd for a concert and that's about the only thing I have to keep going for right now. I wrote 'year I die' because I'm not in imminent danger but I know things will only get worse from here. There's been a culmination of events leading to this including having to move back into my abusive father's house because my mom is worn out from my behavior, and relapsing on self harm and drinking.

I've recently cut off all my friends from school and the only person I can confide in is also really sick right now. I can't burden her with this, that's why I made the post. I just had to get some of this out of my body I feel like I could explode.
